candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record shows no evidence of a hemodynamically significant congenital shunt driving PAH; the PFO demonstrates a pure right-to-left shunt (consequence of elevated pulmonary pressures, not the cause), pulmonary artery pressure is below aortic pressure, and no other structural congenital defect is identified. The reference diagnosis is IPAH with PFO, meaning the PAH is idiopathic and the PFO is a secondary/incidental finding. C001 inverts the causal relationship by labeling the PAH as secondary to congenital heart disease, which is an incompatible etiology subtype.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Asserts PAH secondary to congenital heart disease, whereas the reference specifies IPAH (idiopathic) with PFO as an incidental/associated finding

case_quality_flags: PFO with pure right-to-left shunt is a consequence of IPAH rather than its cause; distinction between Eisenmenger physiology and IPAH+PFO is clinically critical here
Relatively low NT-proBNP (94.2 pg/ml) despite echocardiographic RV enlargement and estimated PASP 55 mmHg is mildly discordant and worth noting
